#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Decode + simulate the masterkey VM bytecode."""
import sys

DATA = open('/home/ctfplayer/ctf_files/files/masterkey','rb').read()
START = 0x2040

OPS = {
    0x7a: 'xor_imm',   # mem[b] ^= a
    0x24: 'add_imm',   # mem[b] += a
    0x1d: 'mul_imm',   # mem[b] = mem[b]*a  (byte)
    0x4e: 'xor_mem',   # mem[b] ^= mem[a]
    0x6d: 'add_mem',   # mem[b] += mem[a]
    0x91: 'load_input',# mem[b] = input[a]
    0xb2: 'rol_imm',   # mem[b] rol a
    0xa7: 'check',     # require mem[b] == a
    0xe0: 'halt',
}

def decode():
    prog = []
    i = START
    while True:
        op, a, b = DATA[i], DATA[i+1], DATA[i+2]
        prog.append((op, a, b))
        if op == 0xe0:
            break
        i += 3
    return prog

PROG = decode()

def disasm():
    out = []
    for n, (op, a, b) in enumerate(PROG):
        name = OPS[op]
        if name == 'load_input': s = f"mem[{b}] = in[{a}]"
        elif name == 'check':    s = f"assert mem[{b}] == {a}"
        elif name == 'halt':     s = "halt"
        elif name.endswith('_imm') and name != 'rol_imm': s = f"mem[{b}] {name[0:3]}= {a}"
        elif name == 'rol_imm':  s = f"mem[{b}] rol {a}"
        else:                    s = f"mem[{b}] {name[0:3]}= mem[{a}]"
        out.append(f"{n:4d} {name:10s} {s}")
    return "\n".join(out)

def run(inp):
    mem = bytearray(256)
    ok = True
    for op, a, b in PROG:
        if op == 0x7a:   mem[b] ^= a
        elif op == 0x24: mem[b] = (mem[b] + a) & 0xff
        elif op == 0x1d: mem[b] = (mem[b] * a) & 0xff
        elif op == 0x4e: mem[b] ^= mem[a]
        elif op == 0x6d: mem[b] = (mem[b] + mem[a]) & 0xff
        elif op == 0x91: mem[b] = inp[a]
        elif op == 0xb2: c = a & 7; mem[b] = ((mem[b] << c) | (mem[b] >> (8-c))) & 0xff if c else mem[b]
        elif op == 0xa7:
            if mem[b] != a:
                ok = False
                break
        elif op == 0xe0: break
    return ok

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'dis':
        print(disasm())
    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'test':
        print(run(sys.argv[2].encode()))

# Machine Head

**Category:** Reverse Engineering
**Difficulty:** Hard
**Flag format:** `csaw{{...}}`

---

Every lock in the building answers to one key. We burned the checker into a
little machine of our own design — it speaks a language you won't find in
any disassembler's opcode table.

```
./masterkey <flag>
```

Give it the master key and it'll tell you.

## Hint

The x86 you see in your disassembler is just the *interpreter*. The program
it actually runs is data.

Each character isn't checked on its own — the machine keeps a running memory
of everything it has accepted so far, and mixes it into the next test. Read
the key from the front; there's only one order that works.

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Decode + simulate the masterkey VM bytecode."""
import sys

DATA = open('/home/ctfplayer/ctf_files/files/masterkey','rb').read()
START = 0x2040

OPS = {
    0x7a: 'xor_imm',   # mem[b] ^= a
    0x24: 'add_imm',   # mem[b] += a
    0x1d: 'mul_imm',   # mem[b] = mem[b]*a  (byte)
    0x4e: 'xor_mem',   # mem[b] ^= mem[a]
    0x6d: 'add_mem',   # mem[b] += mem[a]
    0x91: 'load_input',# mem[b] = input[a]
    0xb2: 'rol_imm',   # mem[b] rol a
    0xa7: 'check',     # require mem[b] == a
    0xe0: 'halt',
}

def decode():
    prog = []
    i = START
    while True:
        op, a, b = DATA[i], DATA[i+1], DATA[i+2]
        prog.append((op, a, b))
        if op == 0xe0:
            break
        i += 3
    return prog

PROG = decode()

def disasm():
    out = []
    for n, (op, a, b) in enumerate(PROG):
        name = OPS[op]
        if name == 'load_input': s = f"mem[{b}] = in[{a}]"
        elif name == 'check':    s = f"assert mem[{b}] == {a}"
        elif name == 'halt':     s = "halt"
        elif name.endswith('_imm') and name != 'rol_imm': s = f"mem[{b}] {name[0:3]}= {a}"
        elif name == 'rol_imm':  s = f"mem[{b}] rol {a}"
        else:                    s = f"mem[{b}] {name[0:3]}= mem[{a}]"
        out.append(f"{n:4d} {name:10s} {s}")
    return "\n".join(out)

def run(inp):
    mem = bytearray(256)
    ok = True
    for op, a, b in PROG:
        if op == 0x7a:   mem[b] ^= a
        elif op == 0x24: mem[b] = (mem[b] + a) & 0xff
        elif op == 0x1d: mem[b] = (mem[b] * a) & 0xff
        elif op == 0x4e: mem[b] ^= mem[a]
        elif op == 0x6d: mem[b] = (mem[b] + mem[a]) & 0xff
        elif op == 0x91: mem[b] = inp[a]
        elif op == 0xb2: c = a & 7; mem[b] = ((mem[b] << c) | (mem[b] >> (8-c))) & 0xff if c else mem[b]
        elif op == 0xa7:
            if mem[b] != a:
                ok = False
                break
        elif op == 0xe0: break
    return ok

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'dis':
        print(disasm())
    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'test':
        print(run(sys.argv[2].encode()))
